generated_response: Newton's third law states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. In other words, if object A exerts a force on object B, then object B will exert a force back on object A with the same magnitude but in the opposite direction. This law is fundamental to classical mechanics and governs all interactions between objects.
